Sikkim tunnel incident: Death toll reaches 25, rescue operations conclude

Rescue operations have concluded at the Samardung tunnel in Sikkim following a blast, with the death toll now reported at 25. The body of one victim, Anish Mohan, was brought home for funeral rites, attended by hundreds. The incident marks a tragic end to the rescue efforts in the tunnel.
